CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

contest.text: (Competitor) and (Visitor) prepare signature dishes. A formidable Isolan cook joins the panel and tastes (Competitor)'s stew. "This fish has suffered enough," (isolan.he/she) announces. (Judge1) replies, "Then judge the flavor, not the family that cooked it." The crowd goes silent.
contest.name: The Questionable Feast

a1.text: (Visitor)'s dish wins fairly, and a furious villager accuses the judges of surrendering tradition.

a2.text: (Competitor)'s dish wins, but an Isolan elder calls it stolen from an old shared recipe.

b1.text: Each community's harshest critic unknowingly praises the other's cook.

b2.text: A bowl is mislabeled; organizers discover it and repeat the tasting before announcing a winner.

c1.text: A magnificent joint feast wins over most of the audience, though a few refuse to eat.

c2.text: A fermented experiment smells so appalling that BOTH communities evacuate the square together. Their first unanimous agreement: never cook that again.

d1.text: The cooks discover a common ancestral method.

d2.text: They disagree respectfully and serve separate dishes, with neither forced to renounce the original recipe.

common_b.text: Require a blind or anonymous test of the entries.

common_c.text: Invite the competitors to explain or demonstrate their work.

common_d.text: Allow a mixed panel of elders, practitioners and ordinary villagers to judge.
